dev.sailry.platform.instructions: For questions about diagnostics, errors or type errors, call code_diagnostics first. For references or usage, call code_references first. Fall back to source search only when the query returns not_installed, and say that the required language service is not installed. Read-only code queries use language servers on the execution Node. Use code_catalog for registered installable packages and installed executable availability, code_packages with installed=true for managed receipts and actual versions, and code_servers for actual instances in the current worktree. Installed or installable does not mean running. Use code_start or code_stop only for the exact returned Startup descriptor and current worktree; never fabricate an executable, root or revision. These explicit lifecycle calls follow conversation authorization and do not change enable settings. If a required server is missing, use code_packages or the query package_info to obtain an install descriptor, then call code_install with that exact descriptor and retry the query after successful installation. Install only packages relevant to the user task; installation and updates follow the current conversation authorization policy. Respect disabled services and never change their enable settings. Use code_packages with installed=true before uninstalling, and pass the exact managed package and version to code_uninstall only when removal is requested; uninstall affects every project on this Node and returns busy while the package is being installed or used. Do not use shell package managers to bypass these tools. An Ask-mode cold start requests approval for that workspace and exact server configuration. Results marked indexing or partial are incomplete; corroborate them with relevant source. Query paths are relative to the current worktree, and line numbers start at one.

tools.name: code_diagnostics
tools.description: Read at most 100 diagnostics for a saved project file. Supply path and optionally severity. A missing server returns not_installed; do not claim the file is error-free.

tools.name: code_definition
tools.description: Locate a literal symbol on a one-based line. Returns confined relative paths and one-based positions. Read the returned files for surrounding code.

tools.name: code_references
tools.description: Find at most 100 references to a literal symbol on a one-based line. Partial or indexing results do not establish the absence of other references.

tools.name: code_hover
tools.description: Read a literal symbol signature and documentation from its one-based line. Output is limited to 8 KiB.

tools.name: code_symbols
tools.description: List document symbols using path, or search symbols on an already running project server using query. A project query does not scan or start arbitrary servers.

tools.name: code_packages
tools.description: Set installed=false to list project language candidates and exact install descriptors. Set installed=true to list Node-managed installations and actual versions for removal. This does not install or start anything.

tools.name: code_catalog
tools.description: List the Node language registry, available package install descriptors and installed executable availability. Installed is not Running; use code_packages for managed actual versions and code_servers for running instances.

tools.name: code_servers
tools.description: List actual language server instances owned by the current worktree. Copy the exact Startup descriptor for start or stop; catalog package availability does not prove a server is running.

tools.name: code_start
tools.description: Start an installed language server for this worktree using all fields of its returned Startup descriptor. Follow conversation approval; do not fabricate an executable, root, worktree or revision, or toggle service settings.

tools.name: code_stop
tools.description: Stop the exact language server instance returned for this worktree. Follow conversation approval and copy its full Startup descriptor. This does not uninstall its package or change enable settings.

tools.name: code_install
tools.description: Install or update a Node-wide language package. Copy all fields from the install descriptor returned by a code query or code_packages. Follow conversation approval; do not fabricate URLs, commands or revisions. Retry the original query after success.

tools.name: code_uninstall
tools.description: Remove the exact managed package and version returned by code_packages with installed=true. This affects all projects on the Node, stops only idle owned instances and returns busy while the package is being installed or used. Use only when removal is requested.
